title: Amazon products
description: Two row types share one dataset: product (one product's details, charged) and status (per target, free).

dataset.title: Amazon products
dataset.description: Product detail rows plus one status row per ASIN or URL given. Product rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered, filtered and charged, its not-found, blocked and error tallies, and its HTTP stats.
